ucs.title: [LLM] Lazarus 'Operation DreamJob' — ISO/IMG mount → LNK-launched DLL side-loading via Microsoft/Amazon-signed binary
ucs.description: Hunts the canonical Lazarus / Diamond Sleet / Labyrinth Chollima delivery chain: a fake job-description ISO or IMG is mounted, the user clicks a LNK that invokes a legitimate signed binary (AmazonSSMAgentSetup.exe, msdtc.exe, GoogleUpdate.exe, etc.) from the mounted volume, which then side-loads a trojanized DLL (BLINDINGCAN / LightlessCan / CookieTime). The pivot is execution from a non-C: drive letter parented by explorer.exe followed by network egress from a process running under a removable-image path — Lazarus uses this combination consistently across DreamJob waves against defense, aeros
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name="explorer.exe" AND (Processes.process_path="D:\\*" OR Processes.process_path="E:\\*" OR Processes.process_path="F:\\*" OR Processes.process_path="G:\\*" OR Processes.process_path="H:\\*") AND Processes.process_name IN ("rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","powershell.exe","AmazonSSMAgentSetup.exe","msdtc.exe","GoogleUpdate.exe","VeraCrypt.exe","wsmprovhost.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process Processes.process Processes.process_path Processes.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | join type=left dest user [| tstats summariesonly=true count as egress from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where All_Traffic.dest_category!="internal" by All_Traffic.src All_Traffic.user | rename All_Traffic.src as dest All_Traffic.user as user] | where egress > 0 | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
// Lazarus DreamJob: explorer.exe → process from non-C: mount → LOLbin/signed-binary → network egress
let WindowMin = 5m;
let MountSpawns =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "explorer.exe"
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where FolderPath matches regex @"(?i)^[D-Z]:\\"        // executed from a non-system drive (ISO/IMG/USB mount)
    | where FileName has_any ("rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","powershell.exe","AmazonSSMAgentSetup.exe","msdtc.exe","GoogleUpdate.exe","VeraCrypt.exe","colorui.dll","wsmprovhost.exe")
    | project SpawnTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine, SHA256, InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
MountSpawns
| join kind=inner (
    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName has_any ("rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","powershell.exe","AmazonSSMAgentSetup.exe","msdtc.exe","GoogleUpdate.exe")
    | where InitiatingProcessFolderPath matches regex @"(?i)^[D-Z]:\\"
    | project NetTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, RemotePort, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath
) on DeviceId
| where NetTime between (SpawnTime .. SpawnTime + WindowMin)
| project SpawnTime, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, RemotePort, SHA256
| order by SpawnTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Same logic on Sentinel — Security 4688 + sysmon-style egress via CommonSecurityLog or ImNetworkSession
let WindowMin = 5m;
let MountSpawns =
    SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where ParentProcessName endswith "\\explorer.exe"
    | where NewProcessName matches regex @"(?i)^[D-Z]:\\.*\\(rundll32|regsvr32|mshta|wscript|cscript|powershell|AmazonSSMAgentSetup|msdtc|GoogleUpdate|VeraCrypt|wsmprovhost)\.exe$"
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project SpawnTime=TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName;
MountSpawns
| join kind=inner (
    ImNetworkSession
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where DvcAction !in~ ("deny","drop")
    | where ActingProcessName matches regex @"(?i)^[D-Z]:\\"
    | where not(ipv4_is_private(DstIpAddr))
    | project NetTime=TimeGenerated, Computer=DvcHostname, DstIpAddr, DstHostname, DstPortNumber, ActingProcessName
) on Computer
| where NetTime between (SpawnTime .. SpawnTime + WindowMin)
| project SpawnTime, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, DstIpAddr, DstHostname, DstPortNumber
| order by SpawnTime desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Lazarus DreamJob ISO/IMG Mount LOLbin Side-Load
id: 7a3b2c4f-9d0e-4a8c-bf2a-1d7e6c4b9a31
status: experimental
description: Detects Lazarus Group (Diamond Sleet / Labyrinth Chollima) DreamJob delivery — explorer.exe spawning a LOLbin or signed Microsoft/Amazon binary from a non-system drive letter (mounted ISO/IMG/VHD).
references:
  - https://www.mandiant.com/resources/blog/lightless-can-lazarus-dreamjob
  - https://www.microsoft.com/security/blog/2023/10/18/diamond-sleet-supply-chain-compromise/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/16
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.t1574.002
  - attack.g0032
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\explorer.exe'
  selection_drive:
    Image|re: '(?i)^[D-Z]:\\\\.*'
  selection_image:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\AmazonSSMAgentSetup.exe'
      - '\msdtc.exe'
      - '\GoogleUpdate.exe'
      - '\VeraCrypt.exe'
      - '\wsmprovhost.exe'
  filter_machine_account:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_drive and selection_image and not filter_machine_account
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate portable applications run from USB drives
  - Software installers staged from network shares mapped as drive letters
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\explorer.exe OR *\\EXPLORER.EXE) (@Image:*\\rundll32.exe OR @Image:*\\RunDll32.exe OR @Image:*\\regsvr32.exe OR @Image:*\\RegSvr32.exe OR @Image:*\\mshta.exe OR @Image:*\\MSHTA.EXE OR @Image:*\\wscript.exe OR @Image:*\\WScript.exe OR @Image:*\\cscript.exe OR @Image:*\\powershell.exe OR @Image:*\\PowerShell.exe OR @Image:*\\AmazonSSMAgentSetup.exe OR @Image:*\\msdtc.exe OR @Image:*\\GoogleUpdate.exe OR @Image:*\\VeraCrypt.exe OR @Image:*\\wsmprovhost.exe) (@Image:D\:\\* OR @Image:E\:\\* OR @Image:F\:\\* OR @Image:G\:\\* OR @Image:H\:\\* OR @Image:d\:\\* OR @Image:e\:\\* OR @Image:f\:\\*) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/explorer\.exe/i
| ImageFileName=/^[D-Z]:\\/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(rundll32|regsvr32|mshta|wscript|cscript|powershell|AmazonSSMAgentSetup|msdtc|GoogleUpdate|VeraCrypt|wsmprovhost)\.exe$/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| join({#event_simpleName=NetworkConnectIP4 | NOT cidr("10.0.0.0/8", field=RemoteAddressIP4) | NOT cidr("192.168.0.0/16", field=RemoteAddressIP4) | NOT cidr("172.16.0.0/12", field=RemoteAddressIP4)}, field=aid, include=[RemoteAddressIP4, RemotePort, ContextImageFileName])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, RemoteAddressIP4, RemotePort], function=count())
ucs.rationale: The 'explorer.exe → non-C: drive → signed Microsoft/Amazon binary → public egress within 5 min' chain is a Lazarus-specific signature documented across Mandiant (LightlessCan), Microsoft (Diamond Sleet supply chain), and ESET (Operation In(ter)ception) reporting. Other APTs deliver via ISO too, but Lazarus uniquely combines (a) ISO/IMG containers, (b) abuse of AWS/Google/Microsoft signed update bi

ucs.title: [LLM] Lazarus 'Contagious Interview' / trojanized dev-tool — node.exe or python.exe spawning network-egressing PowerShell/curl
ucs.description: Hunts the Lazarus / Labyrinth Chollima developer-targeting wave: fake recruiter sends a 'coding challenge' GitHub repo, victim runs `npm install` or `pip install` of a poisoned package (BeaverTail / InvisibleFerret / aabquerys), and the package's post-install script spawns powershell/curl/cmd to fetch the second-stage Python implant. This chain — Node.js / Python parent → PowerShell or curl/bitsadmin child → outbound TLS to attacker-controlled domain or raw IP — is unique to Lazarus's developer-recruiting playbook and rarely seen in benign npm/pip flows.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("node.exe","npm.exe","npx.exe","yarn.exe","python.exe","python3.exe","pip.exe","pip3.exe") AND Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","curl.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process Processes.process Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | search process IN ("*http*","*Invoke-WebRequest*","*DownloadString*","*IEX*","*-EncodedCommand*","*FromBase64String*","*WebClient*","*urlopen*","*requests.get*") OR process IN ("*curl*-o*","*bitsadmin*/transfer*","*certutil*-urlcache*") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
// Lazarus Contagious Interview: node/python install → script-host child fetching second stage
let WindowMin = 2m;
let DevSpawn =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("node.exe","npm.exe","npx.exe","yarn.exe","python.exe","python3.exe","pip.exe","pip3.exe")
    | where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","curl.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("http://","https://","Invoke-WebRequest","DownloadString","IEX","Invoke-Expression","-EncodedCommand","FromBase64String","WebClient","urlopen","requests.get","-urlcache","/transfer","curl -o","curl -O","wget ")
    | project SpawnTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentImage=InitiatingProcessFolderPath, ParentCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildImage=FolderPath, ChildCmd=ProcessCommandLine, SHA256;
DevSpawn
| join kind=inner (
    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","curl.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe")
    // exclude legitimate package-registry endpoints — actor C2 is on direct IPs or attacker-owned domains
    | where not(RemoteUrl has_any ("registry.npmjs.org","pypi.org","files.pythonhosted.org","github.com","githubusercontent.com"))
    | project NetTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, RemotePort
) on DeviceId
| where NetTime between (SpawnTime .. SpawnTime + WindowMin)
| project SpawnTime, DeviceName, AccountName, ParentCmd, ChildCmd, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, RemotePort, SHA256
| order by SpawnTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Same intent expressed on Sentinel 4688 + ImNetworkSession
let WindowMin = 2m;
let DevParents = dynamic(["node.exe","npm.exe","npx.exe","yarn.exe","python.exe","python3.exe","pip.exe","pip3.exe"]);
let ScriptHosts = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","curl.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe"]);
let DevSpawn =
    SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | extend ParentName = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1])),
             ChildName  = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
    | where ParentName in (DevParents) and ChildName in (ScriptHosts)
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | where CommandLine has_any ("http://","https://","Invoke-WebRequest","DownloadString","IEX","Invoke-Expression","-EncodedCommand","FromBase64String","WebClient","urlopen","requests.get","-urlcache","/transfer","curl -o","wget ")
    | project SpawnTime=TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine;
DevSpawn
| join kind=inner (
    ImNetworkSession
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where not(ipv4_is_private(DstIpAddr))
    | where not(Url has_any ("registry.npmjs.org","pypi.org","files.pythonhosted.org","github.com","githubusercontent.com"))
    | where ActingProcessName has_any ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","curl.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe")
    | project NetTime=TimeGenerated, Computer=DvcHostname, DstIpAddr, DstHostname, Url, DstPortNumber
) on Computer
| where NetTime between (SpawnTime .. SpawnTime + WindowMin)
| project SpawnTime, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, DstIpAddr, DstHostname, Url, DstPortNumber
| order by SpawnTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (@ParentImage:*\\node.exe OR @ParentImage:*\\Node.exe OR @ParentImage:*\\NODE.EXE OR @ParentImage:*\\npm.exe OR @ParentImage:*\\npx.exe OR @ParentImage:*\\yarn.exe OR @ParentImage:*\\python.exe OR @ParentImage:*\\Python.exe OR @ParentImage:*\\python3.exe OR @ParentImage:*\\pip.exe OR @ParentImage:*\\pip3.exe) (@Image:*\\powershell.exe OR @Image:*\\PowerShell.exe OR @Image:*\\pwsh.exe OR @Image:*\\cmd.exe OR @Image:*\\curl.exe OR @Image:*\\bitsadmin.exe OR @Image:*\\certutil.exe OR @Image:*\\mshta.exe OR @Image:*\\wscript.exe OR @Image:*\\cscript.exe) (@CommandLine:*http* OR @CommandLine:*HTTP* OR @CommandLine:*DownloadString* OR @CommandLine:*Invoke-WebRequest* OR @CommandLine:*FromBase64String* OR @CommandLine:*EncodedCommand* OR @CommandLine:*WebClient* OR @CommandLine:*urlopen* OR @CommandLine:*urlcache* OR @CommandLine:*\/transfer*) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/(node|npm|npx|yarn|python|python3|pip|pip3)\.exe/i
| ImageFileName=/(powershell|pwsh|cmd|curl|bitsadmin|certutil|mshta|wscript|cscript)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(http(s)?:|DownloadString|Invoke-WebRequest|FromBase64String|EncodedCommand|WebClient|urlopen|urlcache|/transfer|requests\.get)", field=CommandLine)
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| join({#event_simpleName=DnsRequest | NOT DomainName=/(npmjs\.org|pypi\.org|pythonhosted\.org|github\.com|githubusercontent\.com)$/i}, field=aid, include=[DomainName, FirstIP4Record])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, DomainName], function=count())
ucs.rationale: Documented Lazarus campaigns 'Contagious Interview' (Unit 42) and the BeaverTail / InvisibleFerret npm-package ecosystem (Phylum, Palo Alto, SocketDev 2024-2025) chain node.exe or python.exe spawning powershell/curl with download-cradle command lines as the second-stage drop. Legitimate npm/pip post-install hooks normally talk to registry.npmjs.org, pypi.org or github raw — Lazarus payloads call o

_field_issues.message: `Public` is not a canonical column of DeviceProcessEvents.
`RemoteIP` is not a column of DeviceProcessEvents; it does exist on DeviceNetworkEvents, DeviceLogonEvents, DeviceEvents, AlertEvidence, ASCDeviceEvents.
`RemoteUrl` is not a column of DeviceProcessEvents; it does exist on DeviceNetworkEvents, DeviceEvents, AlertEvidence, ASCDeviceEvents.
`RemotePort` is not a column of DeviceProcessEvents; it does exist on DeviceNetworkEvents, DeviceLogonEvents, DeviceEvents, ASCDeviceEvents.
`SpawnTime` is not a canonical column of DeviceProcessEvents.
`ParentCmd` is not a canonical column of DeviceProcessEvents.
`ChildCmd` is not a canonical column of DeviceProcessEvents.

_sentinel_field_issues.message: `DvcHostname` is not a column of SecurityEvent; it does exist on ImProcessCreate, ImNetworkSession, ImAuthentication, ImWebSession, ImFileEvent, ImDnsActivity, ImRegistryEvent.
`DstIpAddr` is not a column of SecurityEvent; it does exist on ImNetworkSession, ImWebSession, ImDnsActivity.
`DstHostname` is not a column of SecurityEvent; it does exist on ImNetworkSession, ImWebSession, ImDnsActivity.
`Url` is not a column of SecurityEvent; it does exist on EmailUrlInfo, UrlClickEvents, ThreatIntelligenceIndicator, ImNetworkSession, ImWebSession.
`DstPortNumber` is not a column of SecurityEvent; it does exist on ImNetworkSession, ImWebSession.
`SpawnTime` is not a canonical column of SecurityEvent.
